measurement_notes: Synthetic conditioning, fixed reported steps and disabled EOS measure T2S only.
Earlier desktop processes used five warmups and 30 measured samples per case. The provisional laptop check uses one warmup and three samples; no P95 claim.

Desktop process order: current-a, baseline-a, baseline-b; two current-b attempts were interrupted without a final report. NVIDIA then reported GPU is lost for the RTX 4070 Ti SUPER. No cause is established here.
Final provisional measurements use the healthy RTX 4070 Laptop GPU selected by UUID. No cross-hardware comparison is made.
current-a is exploratory: its FA2 fallback guard was installed after capture. Laptop primary measurements guard capture and runtime; desktop results are retained only as earlier observations.
Natural-EOS V3 smoke records audio lengths, first nonempty/audible chunk arrival, RTF and tokens. It is a compatibility check, not an equal-work speed comparison or listening assessment.
User approved provisional passage after current-device measurements show no anomaly and will provide a later RTX 4070 Ti SUPER retest opportunity. Extended performance validation remains pending.

The representative natural-EOS texts did not fill their initial buckets. Actual promotion is covered by forced-token logit tests and the real-weight fixed-step benchmark; natural-EOS promotion listening remains a follow-up check.
